map.以图表展示成本、收入与利润的关系: Show the relation between cost, revenue and profit as a chart
map.保本销量 = 固定成本 /(单价 - 单位变动成本)。固定成本 10万、单价 1: Break-even volume = fixed cost / (unit price - unit variable cost). With a fixed cost of 100,000, a price of 100 and a variable cost of 60, the break-even volume = 100000/40 = 2500 units; beyond that it is profitable.
map.判断项目是否值得做: Judge whether a project is worth doing
map.单价减单位变动成本（或销售额减变动成本），是每卖一单位先cover变动、再补固定: Unit price minus unit variable cost (or sales revenue minus variable cost) is the amount each unit first contributes to cover the variable costs and then to recover the fixed costs; accumulating it until it covers the fixed costs is the break-even point.
map.可选设置所得税率、图表范围与敏感度幅度: Optionally set the income tax rate, the chart range and the sensitivity span
map.固定成本与变动成本的划分口径会影响保本点，前后必须保持一致: How fixed and variable costs are split affects the break-even point, so the basis must stay consistent throughout
map.填写预计销量: Fill in the expected sales volume

map.边际贡献 = 单价 − 单位变动成本，其累计覆盖固定成本即达到保本: Contribution margin = unit price - unit variable cost; accumulating it until it covers the fixed cost is the break-even point
map.需按产品边际贡献加权或给定销售组合；单一公式只适用单产品或固定比例组合，否则要用: It must be weighted by the contribution margin per product or given a sales mix; a single formula only applies to a single product or a fixed mix, otherwise use the overall contribution margin ratio.
